commands.name: validate-app
commands.description: (skill) Validates a BoltzHub app build against a standard checklist. Inspects the workspace and returns a pass/fail report. Use when the user runs /validate-app or asks to validate their app before pushing.

commands.name: boltzhub
commands.description: (skill) Use when building a new app, or interacting with BoltzHub apps, databases, files, backend code or workflow. Also invoke for: Dynas, Dpyes, appstore, call_bzapi, get_bzapi_spec, dynas tables, records, Python execution, BoltzHub API, .bzhub, app_config.json, AI tools, pebble tools, agent tools.

commands.name: backend-architect
commands.description: (skill) Analyze a frontend app's codebase — routes, components, mock data, types, and UI patterns — to design a complete database architecture and app-level API contract for its backend. Use when the user wants to initialize, design, or plan a backend for an app that currently runs on mock/static data, or when they ask to design a database schema, API structure, or backend architecture for their app. Also use when the user says things like "design my backend", "what tables do I need", "plan the API", or "I need a backend for this app".

commands.name: skill-creator
commands.description: (skill) Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

commands.name: frontend-design
commands.description: (skill) Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, artifacts, posters, or applications (examples include websites, landing pages, dashboards, React components, HTML/CSS layouts, or when styling/beautifying any web UI). Generates creative, polished code and UI design that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

commands.name: app-from-pro-template
commands.description: (skill) Migrates an existing React app into the BZ app template (TanStack Router, TanStack Query, Tailwind v4, Dynas, OAuth). Use when the user wants to convert, migrate, or port a source React app into the BZ/BoltzHub pro template structure. Covers all 8 phases: source app audit, project setup, file copying, import fixes, route tree mapping, component wiring + React Router → TanStack Router conversion, design tokens, Dynas data layer (seed files), and connecting UI to Dynas.

commands.name: model
commands.description: Show or switch the current model

commands.name: live-learn
commands.description: Toggle the live-learning memory system (auto-extraction and retrieval)

commands.name: compact
commands.description: Summarize conversation context to free up token space
